rapport_notes: Handled the piano-on-stairs disappointment with genuine care ("unfortunately we cannot move them up and down any stairs") and stayed warm through it.

evidence_quotes.agenda: "Do you have any special instructions, concerns or stressors about moving in general that you want us to take note of?" - asked after address, piano, and packing were already covered.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised the Sleep Number bed needing special care; rep said "Of course, no problem" and moved on without a follow-up question.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: "If it takes shorter than that, that's totally fine, you only pay for how long it takes" covers the beats-it-pay-less substance.

top_strength: Delivered the piano restriction directly and kindly, then kept the call moving productively toward a quote instead of letting it derail.
coaching_note: The Sleep Number bed concern was acknowledged but never dug into with a follow-up question - a real two-layer probe here would have surfaced more prep needs and built more trust.
